create.name: Aliza Kelly
create.bio:
Aliza Kelly is a professional astrologer and author based in New York, who has spent more than ten years reading birth charts for clients and teaching astrology to a wide public. She works in the modern tropical tradition, usually with Placidus houses, and draws tarot, spellwork, numerology and manifestation practice into her readings. Her tone is warm and playful, and she is known for pairing serious chart work with pop culture and celebrity charts.

She hosts AstroloTea, a twice-weekly podcast and YouTube show with weekly horoscopes on Mondays and deeper lessons on chart placements and tarot on Wednesdays. Since 2019 she has run the Constellation Club, an online membership with coven meetings at each new and full moon and a library of recorded workshops. Her self-paced video classes cover how to read a birth chart, the planets, signs and houses, and tarot. Her books include This Is Your Destiny, on using astrology for intention and growth, the yearlong reflection book It's All Magic, the oracle deck There Are No Coincidences, Starring You for young readers and The Mixology of Astrology. She also tours live astrology shows and leads small retreats.

books.title: This Is Your Destiny
books.author: Aliza Kelly
books.description: Shows how to read your own chart and use what it says to set intentions and make choices, written in a light, conversational voice.

books.title: It's All Magic
books.author: Aliza Kelly
books.description: A book of 365 short daily reflections, prompts and small rituals touching on astrology, tarot and manifestation.

books.title: There Are No Coincidences
books.author: Aliza Kelly
books.description: A pocket-sized deck of 44 cards with a guidebook, built around affirmation, gratitude and noticing synchronicity in daily life.

books.title: Starring You
books.author: Aliza Kelly
books.description: An interactive introduction to astrology for young readers, walking through the signs and the basics of a birth chart.

books.title: The Mixology of Astrology
books.author: Aliza Kelly
books.description: A light-hearted pairing of each zodiac sign's character with cocktail recipes said to suit it.

courses.title: The Sonesta Astrology Experience with Aliza Kelly
courses.description: A three-day, two-night retreat on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, with a birth chart workshop and a guided meditation led by Aliza, plus beach yoga and shared meals. Stay and programme are booked together through the resort.

courses.title: Constellation Club
courses.description: An online membership community with coven meetings led by Aliza at each new and full moon, recorded workshops, downloadable guides and discussion forums.

courses.title: How To Read A Birth Chart Workshop
courses.description: A recorded lecture of about 90 minutes, with slides and a keyword sheet, covering planets, signs, houses, angles and aspects and her method for putting a reading together.

courses.title: Astrology 101: The Planets
courses.description: A recorded class on the personal and outer planets, Chiron and the chart angles, and how to interpret each in a natal chart.

courses.title: Tarot Workshop: Meanings & Interpretation
courses.description: A recorded workshop of about 90 minutes on the 78 cards, telling a story through a spread, and reading for yourself and for others.
